cim: First Parish Hosts Free Community Conversation on Artificial Intelligence Nov. 21
cim_eredeti: First Parish Hosts Free Community Conversation on Artificial Intelligence Nov. 21
szoveg_eredeti:
First Parish on the Common, 75 The Great Road, invites the community to a free, multigenerational “Food for Thought” conversation about artificial intelligence and how it’s shaping people’s lives Saturday, Nov. 21, from 6 to 8 p.m. at the church.

First Parish will provide pizza and salads, but everyone is free to bring a side dish or dessert to share.

“AI, AI, Oh My! Navigating Our Brave New World” is the theme for the evening. It will be a conversation about the impact of artificial intelligence on the daily lives of children and adults alike.

First Parish intends to host these conversations regularly throughout the church year, according to Nathan Sellers, director of faith development for children at First Parish. An earlier session, in November 2025, focused on the effects of bullying — online, at school, at work, and in society at large.

The church is accessible for people who use wheelchairs. Attendees should use the Elm Street entrance.
